calls.title: Wikimedia + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Wikimedia has centralized its experimentation platform, increasing efficiency by running 15-20 experiments per quarter and targeting 100 experiments annually within 18 months. The integration with GrowthBook allows for strict data privacy while offering customizable tools that enable non-data scientists to analyze experiments effectively. Major experiments have led to significant user engagement increases, such as a 40% boost in email confirmations and a 30% rise in account creation. Challenges include AI-driven traffic shifts and maintaining data integrity amidst automated scrapers. Future plans involve scaling experiment volumes, sharing results with the community, and collaborating further with GrowthBook to enhance capabilities.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Wikimedia, experimentation, self-hosted, data privacy, account creation
